summary: Small shared graph kernel used by RelationDAG and Pipeline. Graph[N] holds named nodes, dependency_edges (drive ordering) and constraint_edges with metadata (never affect execution), and provides topological_order, ancestors, descendants, parallel_layers, describe and to_dot. Pure algorithm functions are exposed alongside the container; it holds no execution, caching or persistence.
key_classes: Graph[N] — generic node/edge container with two sharply separated edge sets
CycleError — dependency edges contain a cycle (ValueError)
UnknownNodeError — node name not in graph (KeyError)
key_functions: topological_order(nodes, edges, target) — ordering, optionally restricted to a target's ancestors
parallel_layers(edges, order) — group order into concurrently runnable layers
Graph.add(name, node, *, depends_on=()) — add a node
Graph.add_constraint(parent, child, meta=None) — add constraint edge with deduped metadata
Graph.to_dot(...) — Graphviz DOT with dashed constraint edges
extension_points: Generic node type N; owners supply derived dependency names
